readings.sections_read: p1 introductory correction discussion; pp4–5 context/cost; p9 credibility intervals; p10 local validity advice
readings.confirmed: Structured interviews retain a high mean validity, but the reported .42 mean has an80% credibility interval .18–.66 across settings. This is heterogeneity, not a95% confidence interval on the mean. Authors also discuss development time, cost and applicant context.
readings.limits: No numerical transfer to software recommendations or LLM procedures; this reinspection does not count as another method paper.

readings.sections_read: abstract; results atp4; Table1 atp5; discussion p6
readings.confirmed: In the ECG verification comparison, both conditions had89 interpretations; net errors corrected were26 with checklist and3 without. Verification took63 versus35 seconds and added more characters.
readings.limits: Fifteen experts and repeated ECG interpretation; improved error correction does not mean shorter output or lower elapsed time. Not a human review measurement in AF-RES-018.

readings.sections_read: objective/methods pp0–1; results p5; COMMENT p6
readings.confirmed: The antiplatelet recommendation example lagged cumulative evidence by10 years and the first published meta-analysis by6 years. The discussion identifies evidence volume, publication lag and differing endpoints as possible explanations.
readings.limits: Retrospective cumulative reconstruction and expert reviews were not randomized or matched in information/search budget. Different endpoints can explain some disagreement.
